settings.heading: Shop the bedside
settings.intro: The four pieces from the Gift of Sleep Box, sold on their own: the silk sleep mask, the silk pillowcase, the AM / PM journal and the lavender sleep wrap. Everything here is something we would put in a gift, which is the standard for what gets on the shelf at all.
settings.note: Rather send it? All four together with the ritual card and your message written by hand on the card is the Gift of Sleep Box. It arrives tied, ready to give, with nothing left to assemble.
settings.empty_text: The shelf is being restocked. The Gift of Sleep Box is still available, and every piece in it will be back here soon.
